title: Ampere-level electroreduction of CO2 and CO
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,6973-7016
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00863D, Review Article

Qian Sun, Chen Jia, Haochen Lu, Mengmeng Yang, Ruirui Liu, Dan M. Villamanca, Yong Zhao, Chuan Zhao
This review summarized recent advances in CO2RR/CORR at ampere-level current density (>500 mA cm−2), including mechanisms, and principles for rational catalyst design and mass transport manipulation, along with the challenges and future directions.
